affected_party: organizations and agents reusing quality knowledge across domains and runtimes
actual_problem: portable Decision Patterns and Quality Intents can be copied without preserved provenance, applicability boundaries, counterexamples, trust state, or local-validation status
why_it_matters: foreign or stale quality knowledge can silently become active, authoritative, or executable despite being untested in the target context
why_now: Agent Skills became a vendor-neutral cross-platform standard on 2026-10-22, making governed quality-knowledge portability an immediate adoption boundary
